name: Moomin Museum
description: Interactive museum dedicated to the beloved Moomin characters and their creator Tove Jansson
curator_note: Magical for families; hands-on exhibits capture the enchanting Moomin world.

name: Tampere Cathedral
description: Art Nouveau style cathedral with stunning granite architecture and frescoes
curator_note: Essential landmark with dramatic frescoes; 5-min walk from market square.

name: Särkänniemi
description: Amusement park with aquarium, planetarium, and observation tower with panoramic views
curator_note: All-day destination with aquarium, rides, and restaurant; north of downtown.

name: Pyynikki Park & Tower
description: Scenic park with historic wooden observation tower offering panoramic city views
curator_note: Iconic tower with lake views; scenic walk from downtown, best at sunset.

name: Market Square (Keskustori)
description: Lively central marketplace with local vendors, cafes, and restaurants
curator_note: Heart of downtown; explore local crafts, food stalls, and street performances.

name: Vapriikki Museum
description: Cultural center and museum complex featuring various exhibitions and art spaces
curator_note: Multi-building complex with rotating exhibitions; near railway station.

name: Näsinneula
description: Tall observation tower at Särkänniemi with excellent city and lake views
curator_note: Tallest structure in Tampere; stunning 360-degree views of city and lakes.

name: Amurin Museum
description: Open-air museum showcasing 19th-century working-class living and craft traditions
curator_note: Step back in time with restored homes and traditional crafts demonstrations.

name: Lenin Museum
description: Historic meeting place of Lenin and Stalin with museum exhibits on Russian revolutionary history
curator_note: Unique historical site where Lenin and Stalin secretly met in 1905.

name: Nuolahalli Art Museum
description: Contemporary art museum featuring rotating exhibitions and local artists
curator_note: Contemporary art gallery showcasing emerging Finnish and international artists.
